`<VALUE>` is required; `[VALUE]` is optional; `...` permits multiple values.
Usage lines show required arguments/options. Defaults and accepted enum

`werk help COMMAND …` and `werk COMMAND … --help` display command help.

## werk

Werk1112 imports local or Hugging Face models, routes inference across installed runtimes, serves OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages API subsets, and provides a live terminal dashboard with werk top.

```text
werk [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]
```

Subcommands: [`werk support`](cli-options.md#werk-support), [`werk gpus`](cli-options.md#werk-gpus), [`werk deployment-plan`](cli-options.md#werk-deployment-plan), [`werk top`](cli-options.md#werk-top), [`werk serve`](cli-options.md#werk-serve), [`werk run`](cli-options.md#werk-run), [`werk chat`](cli-options.md#werk-chat), [`werk image`](cli-image.md#werk-image), [`werk video`](cli-video.md#werk-video), [`werk audio`](cli-audio.md#werk-audio), [`werk estimate`](cli-options.md#werk-estimate), [`werk bench`](cli-options.md#werk-bench), [`werk doctor`](cli-options.md#werk-doctor), [`werk backend`](cli-options.md#werk-backend), [`werk artifacts`](cli-options.md#werk-artifacts), [`werk auth`](cli-options.md#werk-auth), [`werk temp`](cli-options.md#werk-temp), [`werk cache`](cli-options.md#werk-cache), [`werk runtime`](cli-options.md#werk-runtime), [`werk import`](cli-options.md#werk-import), [`werk convert`](cli-options.md#werk-convert), [`werk pull`](cli-options.md#werk-pull), [`werk remove`](cli-options.md#werk-remove), [`werk list`](cli-options.md#werk-list), [`werk parameters`](cli-options.md#werk-parameters), [`werk inspect`](cli-options.md#werk-inspect), [`werk select-file`](cli-options.md#werk-select-file).

### Global options

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--log-level <LOG_LEVEL>` | Operational log threshold. --verbose/--verbose-pure default to debug [env: WERK_LOG_LEVEL] [possible values: error, warn, info, debug, trace, off] |
| `--log-format <LOG_FORMAT>` | stderr rendering; auto uses the terminal palette and plain text in pipes [env: WERK_LOG_FORMAT] [default: auto] [possible values: auto, text, json] |
| `--log-file <LOG_FILE>` | Append JSONL events to this file, independently of terminal rendering [env: WERK_LOG_FILE] |
| `--log-max-size-mb <LOG_MAX_SIZE_MB>` | Rotate the JSONL file after this many MiB (one writer per path) [env: WERK_LOG_MAX_SIZE_MB] [default: 10] |
| `--log-retention <LOG_RETENTION>` | Number of rotated files to retain, named PATH.1 through PATH.N [env: WERK_LOG_RETENTION] [default: 5] |
| `--deployments <DEPLOYMENTS>` | Server-owned deployment profiles JSON (serve only) [env: WERK_DEPLOYMENTS] |
| `--model-home <MODEL_HOME>` | Model store directory; defaults to WERK_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME/werk1112, or ~/.local/share/werk1112 [env: WERK_HOME] |
| `--device <DEVICE>` | Candle-only device override for this command: auto, cpu, cuda, or metal [possible values: auto, cpu, cuda, metal] |
| `--backend <BACKEND>` | Backend for this process: auto, cpu, cuda, rocm, vulkan, metal, mlx, omlx, onnx, transformers, vllm, candle, llama-highlevel, or llama-legacy [default: auto] [possible values: auto, candle, cpu, cuda, llama-highlevel, llama-legacy, metal, mlx, omlx, onnx, rocm, transformers, vllm, vulkan] |
| `--auto-install-backends` | Allow Werk to provision missing managed runtime backends during selection |
| `--no-auto-install-backends` | Disable automatic managed runtime provisioning |
| `--parallel <PARALLEL>` | llama-server active sequence slots; default 1; each slot receives --ctx-size tokens [env: WERK_LLAMA_PARALLEL] |
| `--fp4-kernel <FP4_KERNEL>` | NVFP4 CUDA kernel policy; default auto prefers native Blackwell, then Marlin, then GGML [env: WERK_FP4_KERNEL] [possible values: auto, native, marlin, ggml] |
| `--ctx-size <CTX_SIZE>` | llama.cpp context size per sequence; 0 uses the model default [env: WERK_LLAMA_CTX] |
| `--batch-size <BATCH_SIZE>` | llama.cpp logical prompt batch size [env: WERK_LLAMA_BATCH] |
| `--ubatch-size <UBATCH_SIZE>` | llama.cpp physical compute micro-batch size [env: WERK_LLAMA_UBATCH] |
| `--gpu-layers <GPU_LAYERS>` | llama.cpp GPU layers; high values mean all layers [env: WERK_LLAMA_GPU_LAYERS] |
| `--main-gpu <MAIN_GPU>` | llama.cpp main GPU index [env: WERK_LLAMA_MAIN_GPU] |
| `--kv-cache-type <KV_CACHE_TYPE>` | llama.cpp KV cache type: f16, f32, or q8-0 [env: WERK_LLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE] [possible values: f16, f32, q8-0] |
| `--flash-attn [<FLASH_ATTN>]` | Request llama.cpp flash attention when the native runtime exposes it [env: WERK_LLAMA_FLASH_ATTN] [possible values: true, false] |
| `--kv-offload [<KV_OFFLOAD>]` | Control llama.cpp K/Q/V and KV-cache GPU offload [env: WERK_LLAMA_KV_OFFLOAD] [possible values: true, false] |
| `--warmup-tokens <WARMUP_TOKENS>` | Synthetic warmup tokens; 0 disables prewarm. llama-server defaults to off and treats positive values as enabling native warmup [env: WERK_LLAMA_WARMUP_TOKENS] |
| `--threads <THREADS>` | llama.cpp generation CPU helper threads [env: WERK_LLAMA_THREADS] |
| `--threads-batch <THREADS_BATCH>` | llama.cpp prompt-eval CPU helper threads [env: WERK_LLAMA_THREADS_BATCH] |
| `-h, --help` | Print help (see a summary with '-h') |
| `-V, --version` | Print version |

Global options and `--help` are inherited by subcommands unless a local
declaration overrides them. Their backend scope is described in
[Global options](cli.md#global-options).

## werk support


Arguments:

```text
<CONFIG>
```

## werk top

Live Werk dashboard with inference, memory and cache telemetry

```text
werk top [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--url <URL>` | Server root URL without /v1, credentials, query or fragment; HTTP(S). [default: http://127.0.0.1:11434] |
| `--api-key <API_KEY>` | Bearer credential; local servers also support discovery from the default key file. [env: WERK_API_KEY] |
| `--interval-ms <INTERVAL_MS>` | Refresh interval in milliseconds; range 500–60000. [default: 2000] |
| `--once` | Print one snapshot and exit, without entering terminal mode |
| `--json` | Print the snapshot as JSON; requires --once. |
| `--no-animation` | Disable decorative dashboard animation. |
| `--demo` | Preview the dashboard with explicitly simulated data; no server connection |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).

## werk serve

Start the OpenAI-compatible HTTP server

```text
werk serve [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--host <HOST>` | Address to bind [default: 127.0.0.1] |
| `--port <PORT>` | Port to bind [default: 11434] |
| `--model <MODEL>` | Default model for chat or text-analysis API requests that omit model |
| `--preload <MODEL>...` | Load, warm and retain local models in order; hosted models prepare clients without paid inference; repeatable, failures are logged and skipped |
| `--image-model <IMAGE_MODEL>` | Default image model for compatible clients that omit model or use an OpenAI image alias |
| `--api-key <API_KEY>` | Require OpenAI-style Authorization: Bearer <key> for /v1 requests [env: WERK_API_KEY] |
| `--api-keys <PATH>` | Load OpenAI-style bearer keys from an API keys TOML file [env: WERK_API_KEYS] |
| `--allow-unauthenticated` | Disable API key auth for local development |
| `--cors-origin <ORIGIN>` | Allow an exact browser origin; repeat for multiple origins (wildcard and null are rejected) |
| `--verbose` | Debug logs and detailed terminal statistics |
| `--verbose-pure` | Raw JSONL debug logs, without terminal presentation [aliases: --verbose-lite] |
| `--persistence` | Enable persistence defaults for /werk/v1/prefill, oMLX native short-prefix caching during the worker lifetime (auto/disk modes), and automatic prefix caching for local Werk-managed vLLM; remote vLLM remains externally managed |
| `--persistence-mode <PERSISTENCE_MODE>` | Default prefill persistence mode when policy is omitted; implies --persistence [possible values: ephemeral, memory, disk, auto] |
| `--persistence-reuse <PERSISTENCE_REUSE>` | Default prefill reuse policy when policy is omitted; disabled also disables the managed local-vLLM prefix-cache default and oMLX native short-prefix caching; implies --persistence [possible values: disabled, prefer, required] |
| `--persistence-ttl-seconds <PERSISTENCE_TTL_SECONDS>` | Default prefill state TTL in seconds when policy is omitted; implies --persistence |
| `--persistence-pin` | Pin prefill state by default when policy is omitted; implies --persistence |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).

## werk run

Run text, vision, tools, image, audio, or video inference with an installed model

```text
werk run [OPTIONS] <MODEL> [PROMPT]...
```

Arguments:

```text
<MODEL>      Installed model id
  [PROMPT]...  Prompt text
```

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--max-tokens <MAX_TOKENS>` | Maximum generated tokens (default: 256, or request JSON value) |
| `--temperature <TEMPERATURE>` | Sampling temperature |
| `--top-p <TOP_P>` | Nucleus sampling top-p |
| `--seed <SEED>` | RNG seed |
| `--chat-template <CHAT_TEMPLATE>` | Override chat templating: model, generic, phi3, llama3, gemma, chatml, qwen-chatml, or none [possible values: model, generic, phi3, llama3, gemma, chatml, qwen-chatml, none] |
| `--image <PATH_OR_URL>` | Attach an image for VLM-capable backends; may be repeated |
| `--verbose` | Print Ollama-style timing and throughput stats |
| `--debug` | Print backend internals and resolved runtime details |
| `--server <URL>` | Send text/vision/tool requests to an existing werk serve (http://HOST:PORT); configure the worker on serve |
| `--api-key <API_KEY>` | Bearer key for --server [env: WERK_API_KEY] |
| `--request <PATH>` | Read an OpenAI chat request or canonical media InferenceRequest from JSON; - reads stdin |
| `--task <TASK>` | Inference task; inferred when the model has an unambiguous default |
| `--input <MODALITY[:ROLE]=PATH_OR_URL>` | Media input, e.g. audio=clip.wav or image:mask_image=mask.png; repeatable |
| `--set <PATH=VALUE>` | Canonical media parameter, e.g. image.steps=20 or routing.precision=float16; repeatable |
| `--output <PATH>` | Publish media output to a file or directory |
| `--json` | Print structured results; with text streaming, emit NDJSON events |
| `--stream` | Stream generated text; with --json, also stream tool-call deltas |
| `--stream-granularity <STREAM_GRANULARITY>` | Text stream granularity: token or chunk; implies --stream [possible values: token, chunk] |
| `--no-history` | Use only this invocation's messages; conflicts with conversation persistence |
| `--persistence` | Save and resume completed chat turns across restarts for every backend; native KV reuse depends on the backend |
| `--session <NAME>` | Persistent conversation name for this model (default: default); implies --persistence |
| `--persistence-reuse <PERSISTENCE_REUSE>` | Conversation reuse: prefer resumes if present, required needs a saved conversation, disabled starts fresh; implies --persistence [possible values: disabled, prefer, required] |
| `--persistence-mode <PERSISTENCE_MODE>` | Conversation storage: disk/auto survives exit; memory/ephemeral lasts only for this process; implies --persistence [possible values: ephemeral, memory, disk, auto] |
| `--persistence-ttl-seconds <PERSISTENCE_TTL_SECONDS>` | Expire saved conversation after this many seconds; implies --persistence |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).

## werk chat

Start an interactive terminal chat with an installed model

```text
werk chat [OPTIONS] <MODEL>
```

Arguments:

```text
<MODEL>  Installed model id
```

| Option | Meaning / parser default |

| `--temperature <TEMPERATURE>` | Sampling temperature |
| `--top-p <TOP_P>` | Nucleus sampling top-p |

| `--no-history` | Do not include previous chat turns in the next prompt |
| `--image <PATH_OR_URL>` | Attach images to each turn for VLM-capable backends; may be repeated |
| `--stream-granularity <STREAM_GRANULARITY>` | How terminal chat streams text: token or chunk [default: token] [possible values: token, chunk] |
| `--verbose` | Print Ollama-style timing and throughput stats |
| `--debug` | Print backend internals and resolved runtime details |
| `--persistence` | Save and resume completed chat turns across restarts for every backend; native KV reuse depends on the backend |
| `--session <NAME>` | Persistent conversation name for this model (default: default); implies --persistence |
| `--persistence-reuse <PERSISTENCE_REUSE>` | Conversation reuse: prefer resumes if present, required needs a saved conversation, disabled starts fresh; implies --persistence [possible values: disabled, prefer, required] |
| `--persistence-mode <PERSISTENCE_MODE>` | Conversation storage: disk/auto survives exit; memory/ephemeral lasts only for this process; implies --persistence [possible values: ephemeral, memory, disk, auto] |
| `--persistence-ttl-seconds <PERSISTENCE_TTL_SECONDS>` | Expire saved conversation after this many seconds; implies --persistence |

## werk estimate

Estimate whether a local or Hugging Face model is likely to fit in memory

```text
werk estimate [OPTIONS] <MODEL>
```

Arguments:

```text
<MODEL>  Installed model id or Hugging Face repo id
```

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--task <TASK>` | Estimate an inference task using the canonical media request pipeline |
| `--width <WIDTH>` | Requested output width |
| `--height <HEIGHT>` | Requested output height |
| `--frames <FRAMES>` | Requested video frame count |
| `--duration <SECONDS>` | Requested output duration |
| `--batch-size <BATCH_SIZE>` | Requested batch size |
| `--sample-rate <SAMPLE_RATE>` | Requested audio sample rate |
| `--channels <CHANNELS>` | Requested audio channel count |
| `--steps <STEPS>` | Requested diffusion or sampling step count |
| `--file <FILE>` | For remote Hugging Face estimates, select a repository file; matching GGUF shards are included automatically |
| `--json` | Print machine-readable estimate JSON |
| `--verbose` | Print weight-file accounting details |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).

## werk bench


| Option | Meaning / parser default |

| `--max-tokens <MAX_TOKENS>` | Maximum generated tokens per run [default: 256] |
| `--runs <RUNS>` | Measured runs [default: 5] |
| `--warmups <WARMUPS>` | Warmup runs before measurement [default: 1] |
| `--temperature <TEMPERATURE>` | Benchmark sampling temperature; 0 uses greedy decoding [default: 0] |
| `--top-p <TOP_P>` | Benchmark nucleus sampling top-p |
| `--seed <SEED>` | Benchmark RNG seed [default: 42] |
| `--compare <COMPARE>` | Also benchmark another backend family [default: none] [possible values: none, legacy] |
| `--print-native-info` | Print resolved llama.cpp runtime settings |
| `--json` | Print machine-readable benchmark JSON |
| `--include-output` | Include generated text in benchmark JSON for quality review |
| `--debug` | Print backend internals during benchmark runs |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).

## werk artifacts

Manage optimized runtime artifacts for installed models

```text
werk artifacts [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

## werk runtime

Inspect and control a running Werk runtime

```text
werk runtime [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

Subcommands: [`werk runtime info`](cli-options.md#werk-runtime-info), [`werk runtime capabilities`](cli-options.md#werk-runtime-capabilities), [`werk runtime memory`](cli-options.md#werk-runtime-memory), [`werk runtime states`](cli-options.md#werk-runtime-states), [`werk runtime state`](cli-options.md#werk-runtime-state), [`werk runtime prune`](cli-options.md#werk-runtime-prune).

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |

## werk import

Import local models, copying their files or binding external paths

```text
werk import [OPTIONS] <PATH>
```

Arguments:

```text
<PATH>  Model file or directory, or a collection directory with --all
```

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--name <NAME>` | Installed model id; required unless --all is used |
| `--all` | Import each model directly inside a collection directory, preserving existing Werk model ids |
| `--link` | Register the existing model in place without copying its files |
| `--vision` | Set up image input for this backend/model; does not prove image inference |
| `--text-only` | Skip optional image components and keep this setup text-only |
| `--offline` | Do not contact repositories or install packages (existing-asset setup only) |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).

## werk convert

Convert an installed NVFP4 Hugging Face model to a separate GGUF model

```text
werk convert [OPTIONS] --name <NAME> <MODEL>
```

Arguments:

```text
<MODEL>  Installed source model id
```

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--to <TO>` | Destination model format. [default: gguf] [possible values: gguf] |
| `--name <NAME>` | New model id; existing models are never overwritten |
| `--converter <CONVERTER>` | Path to llama.cpp convert_hf_to_gguf.py |
| `--python <PYTHON>` | Python interpreter with converter dependencies installed |
| `--verbose` | Show converter diagnostics. |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).

## werk pull


Arguments:

```text
<REPO>  Hugging Face repo id, for example org/model
```

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--name <NAME>` | Installed model id; defaults to the repo id |
| `--file <FILE>` | Download a repository file, for example model.Q4_K_M.gguf; matching GGUF shards are included automatically |
| `--vision` | Set up image input for this backend/model; does not prove image inference |
| `--text-only` | Skip optional image components and keep this setup text-only |
| `--offline` | Do not contact repositories or install packages (existing-asset setup only) |
| `--projector <PROJECTOR>` | Select an exact model-specific projector file from this repository |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).

## werk backend install

Install a managed runtime backend

```text
werk backend install [OPTIONS] <BACKEND>
```

Arguments:

```text
<BACKEND>
          Backend to install, for example llama-cuda, onnx-cuda, vllm, or qwen-tts

          Possible values:
          - llama-cuda
          - llama-cuda-nvfp4:   Pinned CUDA runtime with native NVFP4 and standalone Marlin kernels
          - llama-cuda-offload: Experimental pinned CUDA runtime with MoE caching and lazy PLE reads
          - llama-rocm
          - llama-vulkan
          - llama-metal
          - llama-cpu
          - onnx-cuda
          - onnx-rocm
          - onnx-cpu
          - vllm
          - omlx:               Install the managed oMLX CLI on Apple Silicon (explicit installation only)
          - mlx:                Install official MLX-LM on Apple Silicon
          - mlx-vlm:            Install MLX-VLM on Apple Silicon
          - transformers:       Install Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch
          - media:              Install Diffusers, Transformers and media codecs
          - qwen-tts
          - text-analysis
```

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--vision` | Set up image input for this backend/model; does not prove image inference |
| `--text-only` | Skip optional image components and keep this setup text-only |
| `--offline` | Do not contact repositories or install packages (existing-asset setup only) |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).


## werk cache purge

Remove a listed cache, or all inactive caches with --all

```text
werk cache purge [OPTIONS] <CACHE|--all>
```

Arguments:

```text
[CACHE]  Exact cache ID from werk cache list
```

Saved chat histories are excluded from --all unless --include-history or --kind chat-history is supplied. Active or protected entries are skipped. Model weights are never removed.

| Option | Meaning / parser default |
| --- | --- |
| `--all` | Remove all inactive, unprotected caches |
| `--kind <KIND>` | Limit --all to this storage type [possible values: chat-kv, chat-history, omlx-worker, runtime-state] |
| `--include-history` | Also delete saved chat histories with --all |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would be removed without deleting anything |
| `--json` | Print machine-readable JSON |

Also accepts the [global options](#global-options).
